quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: Your manager praises your work in front of the entire team during a meeting.
quests.hint: Your hard work has just been recognized in front of others.
quests.explanation: Being praised for good work, especially publicly, usually makes you feel proud.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You discover that a close friend was not honest with you about something important.
quests.hint: Someone you trust let you down.
quests.explanation: Discovering that someone you trust was not honest with you makes you feel hurt.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: The waiter brings you a completely different dish from the one you ordered.
quests.hint: This is not what you asked for, and now you have to sort it out.
quests.explanation: Receiving the wrong order at a restaurant typically makes you feel annoyed.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: Your phone rings with an unknown number at midnight.
quests.hint: A call at this hour is unusual, and you do not know who it is.
quests.explanation: An unexpected late-night call from an unknown number often makes you feel uneasy.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: The bus arrives at the exact moment you reach the stop, even though you are running late.
quests.hint: Something worked out perfectly at just the right time.
quests.explanation: Good timing that saves you from a problem makes you feel relieved.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: Your manager cancels an important meeting five minutes before it starts, with no explanation.
quests.hint: Something changed suddenly, and you do not know why.
quests.explanation: An unexplained last-minute change like this usually leaves you feeling confused.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You walk into a room full of people, and they all suddenly go quiet.
quests.hint: You suddenly feel like everyone might be looking at you.
quests.explanation: When a room goes quiet as you enter, you often feel self-conscious - unusually aware of yourself.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You try a new hobby for the first time and enjoy it much more than you expected.
quests.hint: You have just discovered something you might want to keep doing.
quests.explanation: Unexpectedly loving a new activity makes you feel enthusiastic about continuing it.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: Someone is sitting in your reserved seat on the train, and they refuse to move.
quests.hint: Something that belongs to you is being taken, and the person will not cooperate.
quests.explanation: Having your reserved seat taken with no cooperation makes you feel irritated.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You get a message saying your flight has been delayed by three hours.
quests.hint: Your plans just got a lot longer with no warning.
quests.explanation: An unexpected long delay to your travel plans naturally makes you feel frustrated.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: A stranger smiles warmly at you as you pass each other on the street.
quests.hint: A small, kind gesture from someone you do not even know.
quests.explanation: A warm smile from a stranger, even a brief one, can leave you feeling uplifted.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You cannot remember something important that a colleague told you just yesterday.
quests.hint: The information is gone, and you know you will need it again soon.
quests.explanation: Forgetting something you were told recently can leave you feeling flustered.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You finally finish reading a long, dull report for work.
quests.hint: A task you did not enjoy is finally over.
quests.explanation: Finishing a task you found boring or difficult usually brings a feeling of relief.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: Your phone battery dies at the exact moment you need directions most.
quests.hint: You suddenly have no way to find your way, right when you needed it.
quests.explanation: Losing something essential exactly when you need it most can make you feel panicked.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You tell a joke at dinner, and the whole table bursts out laughing.
quests.hint: Something you said landed perfectly with everyone.
quests.explanation: Making a group of people laugh together usually makes you feel delighted.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: Your hometown is featured in a positive story on the national news.
quests.hint: Somewhere you belong to is being recognized in a good way.
quests.explanation: Seeing your hometown praised publicly usually makes you feel proud.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You are asked to give a short speech in front of one hundred people with no warning.
quests.hint: A big audience and no time to prepare.
quests.explanation: Speaking to a large audience with no preparation time often makes people feel anxious.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You find twenty pounds inside the pocket of a jacket you have not worn in months.
quests.hint: You just gained money you had completely forgotten about.
quests.explanation: Unexpectedly finding money makes most people feel delighted.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: Your neighbor plays loud music well past midnight, night after night.
quests.hint: This keeps happening, and you have had enough of it.
quests.explanation: A problem that keeps repeating with no change often leaves you feeling exasperated.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: Your doctor tells you that every one of your test results came back completely clear.
quests.hint: You were waiting anxiously, and the news is good.
quests.explanation: Hearing that test results are clear after a period of worry brings relief.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: Your card is declined at the supermarket checkout with a long queue behind you.
quests.hint: Something is going wrong, and other people are waiting and watching.
quests.explanation: Having a payment problem in front of a queue of people often makes you feel embarrassed.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You are asked to work late for the third evening this week.
quests.hint: Your energy has been running low for days.
quests.explanation: Working extra hours repeatedly without rest usually leaves you feeling exhausted.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You accidentally send a private message meant for a friend to your manager instead.
quests.hint: Something private just went to completely the wrong person.
quests.explanation: Accidentally sending something private to the wrong person can leave you feeling mortified - extremely embarrassed.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You receive a full refund for a faulty product without even having to ask twice.
quests.hint: A problem was fixed more easily than you expected.
quests.explanation: Getting a problem resolved smoothly and fairly leaves you feeling satisfied.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: A project you spent several months working on ultimately does not succeed.
quests.hint: A lot of effort did not lead to the result you hoped for.
quests.explanation: Putting months of effort into something that fails can leave you feeling disheartened.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: A colleague you deeply respect gives you a genuine, specific compliment.
quests.hint: This praise means more because of who it came from.
quests.explanation: A sincere compliment from someone you admire often makes you feel honored.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: Your internet connection drops in the middle of an important video call at work.
quests.hint: Technology fails you at a critical moment.
quests.explanation: Losing your connection during something important typically makes you feel frustrated.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You unexpectedly meet your favorite author while browsing at a small bookshop.
quests.hint: Someone you admire from a distance is suddenly right in front of you.
quests.explanation: Unexpectedly meeting someone you admire can leave you feeling starstruck.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: The restaurant brings you someone else's bill, listing food you never ordered.
quests.hint: The numbers in front of you do not match what actually happened.
quests.explanation: Receiving a bill that does not match your order naturally leaves you feeling confused.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You wake up a full hour before your alarm and cannot fall back asleep.
quests.hint: You wanted more rest, but your body had other plans.
quests.explanation: Losing extra sleep you were counting on often leaves you feeling irritated.
